name: Human-readable plan format
target_outcome_row: At least 10 plan reviews before execution

findings.check: Russian-first explanation of what the plan will accomplish and why
findings.evidence: Sections 0, 1 and 2 explain in Russian the target outcome, why dashboard/API evidence is insufficient, and why runtime/token/quality/learnability evidence is required.

findings.check: UML/PlantUML sections are understandable and include examples/simulations/expected outcomes
findings.evidence: Sections 3, 3.1 and 3.2 include importable PlantUML, a scenario simulation, and expected outcomes for important connections.

findings.check: No-code algorithm descriptions explain step-by-step logic and data movement
findings.evidence: Sections 4.1 through 4.6 describe host runtime, token, quality, local learning, target/rollback and branch examples without requiring code reading.

findings.check: Detailed no-code plus code quote references exist without bloated docs
findings.evidence: Section 5.1 adds compact Russian short-code-quote references for XiigenExtensionRequest, XiigenExtensionResponse, ProcessHostExtensionRequest, debug trace formatting and ShouldClaimSemanticQuality.

findings.check: Tables/JSON-like labels support the explanation and do not replace it
findings.evidence: The plan starts with prose and examples; tables support target outcomes, artifacts, phases, and gates.

findings.check: Execution remains locked until 10 plan reviews pass
findings.evidence: Sections 0, 8, 9.2 and 10 keep execution unauthorized until ten current fresh plan-review passes and a fresh Luba execution approval exist.

recheck_evidence: Re-read plan Sections 0, 1, 2, 3, 3.1, 3.2, 4.1-4.6, 5, 5.1, 8, 9.2 and 10 after repair. Required rg terms passed, JSON/JSONL parsing passed, and git diff --check passed.
